newsitem.title: UK: UK shares gain, GKN up 4 pct as results please.
newsitem.headline: UK shares gain, GKN up 4 pct as results please.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 pushed towards record levels in early trade on Tuesday, led by GKN as the engineering group's results beat analyst expectations.

With GKN up four percent after reporting a 12 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 203 million stg, and with results from other leading companies beating expectations, the FTSE 100 was up 12.6 points at 4,973.2 by 0740 GMT.
Gainers were in a five-to-three majority as the FTSE 100 -- which on Tuesday leapt 64.9 points -- advanced towards its intraday peak of 4,998.1 set on July 18.
